changelog:
- Initial release of multichain-protocol skill v1.0.0.
- Instantly turn any AI agent into a wallet for 19 blockchain networks via MeneseSDK on ICP.
- Supports cross-chain token transfers, swaps on popular DEXes (Raydium, Uniswap, ICPSwap, KongSwap, Cetus, Minswap), bridging, DeFi management (Aave, Lido, LPs), trading automation (DCA, stop-loss, rebalancing), and payment processing.
- Free to use for first 5 transactions; read-only operations are always free.
- Provides both canister and CLI integration modes, with detailed quickstart instructions and best practices for address caching.
- Requires installation of dfx and python3; EVM operations require user-supplied RPC endpoints.
